svg.title: Loupe — compose, inspect, verify
svg.desc: A magnifying lens centred on source code. Five capability stages — SBOM (Syft, cdxgen), CVE (Grype, osv-scanner), ThreatLens (Claude, LLM consensus), Secret (gitleaks, TruffleHog), and SAST (Semgrep, CodeQL) — feed into a Merkle-linked run pack at .loupe/runs/01HKXY7Z3F containing five blocks. The pack is then verified end-to-end, and a synthesised REPORT.MD reports PASS, 5 of 5, SHA-256, verified, with 3 high CVEs, 7 threat notes, 12 lints, and zero leaks.

g.text: 3 high CVEs · 7 threat notes · 12 lints · 0 leaks · merkle-sealed
